title: The Honest Merchant
text: A merchant on the otherworld road, plump and pleasant, behind a cart with a sign that reads HONEST PRICES. She means it. She is, unsettlingly, entirely honest, and out here that is the strangest thing any of you have seen.

outcomes.text: A fair price for a fine thing. It feels like a trick, and it is not.

options.label: Sell her what you have spare.

outcomes.text: A fair price, counted out in front of you. Unsettling.

options.label: The wisest asks why she is honest out here.

outcomes.text: She tells you, and it is the best advice you have had in years.
